mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals the start of a tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: early stage of a tightening cycle
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
